prompt: Rewrite this note as a clear, friendly notice for apartment residents: 'The hallway painting starts Tuesday. There will be workers. Bikes and boxes are in the way. Move them Monday night. We think the job ends Thursday, but the weather may affect drying.' Preserve the uncertainty. Please answer in roughly 80 words.
text:
**Notice to Residents**

Hallway painting is scheduled to begin Tuesday. Workers will be present in the building throughout the project. Please remove all bicycles, boxes, and other belongings from the hallways by Monday night so the crew can work safely and efficiently.

We expect the painting to be completed by Thursday. However, drying times may be affected by the weather, so the schedule could change. Thank you for your cooperation and patience while we improve our shared spaces!
